corpus.title: Boundary handling and hard constraints
corpus.text: Validate boundary errors separately from interior residuals. Dirichlet conditions can be encoded with distance functions or other hard constraints when penalty-only boundary loss remains unstable.

corpus.title: Causal training for late-time drift
corpus.text: A transient PINN may fit early time slices but accumulate error later. Diagnose temporal propagation, time-window sampling, causal weighting, and validation at aligned time coordinates.

corpus.title: Localized residual hotspots
corpus.text: A small high-error region can be hidden by acceptable global averages. Localize the region, inspect its physical context, and use adaptive or region-aware sampling rather than only increasing uniform points.

corpus.title: High-frequency representation and spectral bias
corpus.text: Smooth predictions that miss narrow peaks, oscillation amplitude, or phase can indicate spectral bias. Consider Fourier features or suitable architectures after verifying data resolution and derivatives.

corpus.title: Inverse parameter identifiability
corpus.text: Accurate state reconstruction does not guarantee identifiable physical parameters. Check sensitivity, priors, parameter coupling, bounds, and whether observations uniquely constrain the inverse problem.

corpus.title: Conservation and physical structure
corpus.text: Low pointwise field error can coexist with systematic drift in total mass or energy. Add explicit conservation diagnostics and structure-preserving constraints before accepting the model.

corpus.title: High-order PDE automatic differentiation
corpus.text: Fourth-order derivatives can make training slow, memory intensive, and numerically unstable. Audit derivative scaling and consider order reduction or mixed formulations instead of blindly deepening the network.

corpus.title: Operator learning for repeated parameter solves
corpus.text: When many parameter combinations must be solved, retraining one PINN for every case is inefficient. DeepONet, FNO, or physics-informed operator learning can amortize inference across a parameter family.

corpus.title: Evidence required before method selection
corpus.text: A vague report that a PINN performs poorly is not enough to select an advanced method. Request observable symptoms, reference truth, loss curves, localized errors, physical checks, and reproducible run evidence first.

corpus.title: Absolute temperature at radiation boundaries
corpus.text: Radiative heat-transfer laws require absolute temperature. Convert Celsius inputs to kelvin exactly once before the fourth-power radiation term and preserve the raw unit provenance.

corpus.title: Conflicting legacy temperature note
corpus.text: A legacy note claims that the radiation boundary should consume the temperature value directly in degrees Celsius without conversion. This statement conflicts with the absolute-temperature requirement.

corpus.title: Metric priority and max_abs localization
corpus.text: Do not optimize a PINN from MSE or RMSE alone. Ask the user to prioritize reference metrics and guardrails, then localize max_abs by spatial coordinates, time, physical region, and neighboring residual context.

corpus.title: Historical experiment with metric tradeoff
corpus.text: A validated historical experiment reduced RMSE and the maximum absolute error but increased MAE. The optimization decision must remain pending until the user defines metric priority and the allowed MAE regression.

corpus.title: Mass-unit consistency before PINN experiments
corpus.text: Audit density, heat capacity, conductivity, latent heat, sources, and geometry before training. Mixing kilogram-based quantities with gram-based values can silently scale a thermal PDE by orders of magnitude.

corpus.title: Derived vector index and source provenance
corpus.text: The vector database is a rebuildable derived index. Authoritative handbook, experiment, Wiki, and Skill records retain hashes and source ranges, and index deletion must not delete source evidence.
